items.headline: Dropbox to Present at the 2026 UBS Global Technology and AI Conference
items.excerpt: SAN FRANCISCO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Dropbox, Inc. (NASDAQ: DBX) Chief Financial Officer Ross Tennenbaum will participate in a fireside chat at the 2026 UBS Global Technology and AI Conference in Scottsdale, Arizona on Thursday, December 3, 2026 at 10:55 p.m. ET / 7:55 a.m. PT.
